data.name: Battle Ward
data.description: The shaman touches a willing creature (including herself) and grants a battle ward. The next time a foe makes an attack roll against the target, the ward activates and grants a +%1 deflection bonus to the warded creature's AC. Each subsequent time she's attacked, the defection bonus reduces by 1 (to +%2 for the second time she's attacked and +%3 for the third). The ward fades when the bonus is reduced to +0 or after 24 hours, whichever comes first.|ShamanBattleWardStartingBonus|ShamanBattleWardStartingBonus-1|ShamanBattleWardStartingBonus-2
